prompt:
Read 01-requirements.md (and 02-impact-analysis.md, if present) and write 02-design.md.

Use this project's existing technology stack — do not introduce a new language or framework. Its pyproject.toml:

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "service"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Greenfield service scaffold — orchestrator-approved template"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = []

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.3.0",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0.0",
    "ruff>=0.6.0",
    "mypy>=1.11.0",
    "pip-audit>=2.7.0",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
extend-select = ["B", "S", "C90", "PLR0912", "PLR0913", "PLR0915"]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10

[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]
max-args = 5

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# pytest uses the `assert` statement by design; S101 (assert used) is a
# false positive in test files.
"tests/**" = ["S101"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true
python_version = "3.11"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "--cov=service --cov-report=term-missing"

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["service"]

[tool.coverage.report]
fail_under = 85
